title: Global carbon emissions may have peaked in 2026 – but only time will tell
paragraphs: A new report suggests this year, carbon emissions may begin to trend downward for the first time.
But it’s important to take this with a grain of salt. While news reports have hailed this event, it will take years to confirm it wasn’t just a blip caused by the US-Iran war.

Carbon emissions are produced by the burning of coal, gas and oil in power stations, factories, vehicles and heating systems across the globe. To avoid the most dangerous consequences of climate change, the world must reach net zero emissions by mid-century. Worryingly, research shows CO₂ emissions have been on an upward trajectory for most of the industrial age, with 50% of all emissions produced since 1990.
